description: This file defines functions and constants for setting up and configuring Discord integration within the openclaw project, including allowlist management, parsing IDs, and creating setup wizard objects.

methods.name: setDiscordGuildChannelAllowlist
methods.description: Updates the guilds and channels allowlist in the configuration for a specific account.

methods.name: parseDiscordAllowFromId
methods.description: Parses a string to extract a Discord user ID or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: createDiscordSetupWizardBase
methods.description: Creates a base setup wizard object for Discord configuration, including credentials, group access, and policies.

methods.name: createDiscordSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for the Discord setup wizard with fallback allowlist resolution.
